description: This file defines functions for converting JIT schema functions into dispatcher API components in PyTorch, focusing on translating function schemas into C++ types and argument lists for the dispatcher. It handles naming, argument typing, and argument preparation for JIT-to-dispatcher translation.

methods.name: str name(func: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Returns the name of a FunctionSchema.

methods.name: NamedCType argumenttype_type( t: Type, *, mutable: bool, binds: ArgName, remove_non_owning_ref_types: bool = False, symint: bool = True, )
methods.description: Converts a Type into a NamedCType suitable for dispatcher arguments, with options for mutability and symbolic integers.

methods.name: NamedCType argument_type( a: Argument, *, binds: ArgName, remove_non_owning_ref_types: bool = False, symint: bool = True, )
methods.description: Converts an Argument into a NamedCType for dispatcher usage, using argumenttype_type.

methods.name: CType returns_type(rs: Sequence[Return], *, symint: bool = True)
methods.description: Generates a CType representing the return types of a function schema.

methods.name: list[Argument] jit_arguments(func: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Extracts and converts all arguments from a FunctionSchema into a list of Argument objects.

methods.name: Binding argument( a: Argument, *, remove_non_owning_ref_types: bool = False, symint: bool = True )
methods.description: Creates a Binding object for an Argument with associated type information.

methods.name: list[Binding] arguments(func: FunctionSchema, *, symint: bool = True)
methods.description: Generates a list of Bindings for all arguments in a FunctionSchema.

methods.name: list[Argument] to_argument( a: Argument | TensorOptionsArguments | SelfArgument, )

ctags.name: argument
ctags.signature: ( a: Argument, *, remove_non_owning_ref_types: bool = False, symint: bool = True )

ctags.name: argument_type
ctags.signature: ( a: Argument, *, binds: ArgName, remove_non_owning_ref_types: bool = False, symint: bool = True, )

ctags.name: arguments
ctags.pattern: /^def arguments(func: FunctionSchema, *, symint: bool = True) -> list[Binding]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^def returns_type(rs: Sequence[Return], *, symint: bool = True) -> CType:$/
